diagnosis_en: Nasdaq Watcher: the index is above its 200-day moving average, so the primary trend is still up. Momentum is 1.28% over 1 month and 3.44% over 3 months, with RSI 57 in a neutral range. It sits 3.6% below its 52-week high. The 200-day line is the key level to watch — losing it would flip the primary trend.
